toolCalls.name: StructuredOutput

output.brief:
The fall is not real in the way the report suggests. Brackwater's monthly report counts only cases still in "Incident–Confirmed". Since September, a script running on Brackwater's analyst jump host has been polling for confirmed incidents that are near the 4-hour SLA warning and moving each one to "Suspicious Activity–Monitoring" within minutes. That accounts for 47 cases: 23 in September and 24 in October. These cases had analyst confirmation notes, so they were real malicious activity. Without the moves, confirmed incidents would be about 37 and 36, roughly flat. Containment speed has not improved either; like for like it is about 1h50m, the same as before. Auto-triage and the connector are not the explanation.

My confidence is moderate-high that the moves are real and deliberate in their mechanism. I have not established who ordered them or whether they were meant to evade the SLA.

Do not approve the IR retainer cut or the Brackwater bonus. Reinstate the 47 cases, verify containment, and remove category-edit rights from the integration role. Ask Brackwater for a written explanation before the January renewal. Do not invoice service credits until the cases are verified.
